selection_basis: short_eligibility selected by dynamics_calibration_protocol_v1 using training text only

success_criteria.dynamics_transfer: at 96 cells, median effective state rank exceeds the v2 fixed-degree median and firing remains at most 80 Hz
success_criteria.prediction_transfer: at 96 cells, median teacher-forced or free-running validation accuracy exceeds v2 fixed-degree without the other metric falling by more than 0.01
success_criteria.useful_scaling: 384-cell teacher-forced and free-running medians both exceed 24-cell medians while effective state rank increases
success_criteria.claim_limit: all selection came from train-only state dynamics; validation is used once to assess transfer and remains unsuitable as a final held-out claim
